title:
🎟️ The grand opening tomorrow 🎟️

Our games room will be opening tomorrow at the Landings WellbeingHub relaunch party tomorrow 10-4 ⏰ 

Free for all Blue Pits Housing Action and Newbarn Ltd tenants to access! Inside you will find pool, darts and Xbox games!  🎱 🎯 

Tomorrow’s party will also have karaoke, food, games and raffles!

We can’t wait to see you there 🙂
